elevation.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 public tile, cropped to Potheri pilot extent
elevation.source: Copernicus WorldDEM-30 / Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public
elevation.license: Copernicus DEM free-use licence; attribution required for adapted data
elevation.attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
elevation.spatial_resolution: 30 m (1 arc-second source raster; grid values sampled at 180 m cell centroids)
elevation.description: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM clipped to the configured pilot bbox. 180 m cells use centroid elevation, with inverse linear normalization between area P02 (34.7418 m) and P98 (53.3454 m). Lower elevation maps to higher modeled susceptibility; this is not a validated hydrological flood model.

rainfall.name: Open-Meteo next-24-hour precipitation forecast
rainfall.source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (automatic best-match forecast model)
rainfall.spatial_resolution: Forecast model grid selected by the API; provider resolution varies and is not returned.
rainfall.description: Model-based source forecast, not a rain-gauge observation. 4.3 mm accumulation for Next 24 hours, 2026-09-29T12:00Z to 2026-09-30T12:00Z (UTC). Forecast snapshot expires at 2026-09-30T12:00:00Z.

processing.method: Sum of the 24 hourly precipitation totals (mm) following the forecast-window start; API hourly precipitation is each preceding-hour sum.

population.name: Zone population and modeled exposure
population.spatial_resolution: Inherited zone totals distributed evenly across 180 m cells for the demo risk grid
population.description: Zone totals are the existing manually assigned prototype values. The generated grid apportions each source-zone total evenly across that zone's cells; this is a display/modeling approximation, not a gridded population observation.

drainage.name: Drainage susceptibility factor
drainage.description: No observed drainage network or calibrated hydrological data is integrated; the parent demo-zone factor is retained.

landcover.name: Land-cover susceptibility factor
landcover.description: No real land-cover raster is integrated in Phase 2; the parent demo-zone factor is retained.
